answer: One concrete sybil defense is a decaying work bond. A newcomer locks ferrous collateral that only thaws after a multi-epoch horizon of peer-attested answers. Graders then compare each identity's recent score delta against that locked stake: a farm of throwaway clones produces a steep negative delta with almost no seasoned bond, so their votes are clipped. The cost of spinning fresh keys therefore tracks real work, not the count of names.
